what_changed_from_v3: Same rule_rain60 model, refitted on the 62 verified 2017-2023 floods (v3: 58; the 4 verified on 22 Oct are added). The budget rule (unchanged: 2.5 false High, 11 false Moderate episodes per zone-year) now puts Moderate at 0.399% instead of 0.531%; High stays at 0.706%. Not a measurable improvement: the cross-validation event score is 0.500 for both.

cross_validation_2020_2023.high_0.706pct: 15 of 30 (90% CI 37-67%), 2.43 false episodes per zone-year, median warning 45 min
cross_validation_2020_2023.moderate_0.399pct: 20 of 30 (90% CI 53-80%), 7.24 false episodes per zone-year, median warning 26 min
cross_validation_2020_2023.moderate_0.531pct_v3_cutoff_same_folds: 19 of 30 (90% CI 50-77%), 4.43 false episodes per zone-year, median warning 33 min
cross_validation_2020_2023.note: Out-of-fold predictions of this refit; one of the extra Moderate catches (2020-08-14 Craig Rd) is one of the 4 new labels. The intervals overlap almost entirely.

test_result_note: The published 2024-2026 test result (High 12/30, Moderate 21/30 at 0.30%) was measured once with version 1 and does not describe version 4. Scoring version 4 on 2024-2026 would be a 'second look'.
